dogecoin.text:
Dear @DanhausenAD 

Any idea if Dave Honor has been holding back this dogecoin?  It was supposed to go to the moon today and I'm sifting for answers.  Also...coinhausen?

I've been following this neo-#dogecoin movement, and on the surface it's a million lunatics who have all picked arbitrary numbers they want it it go to, and through force of will are winning again all odd or reason.  Also, I'm up a couple grand.  

#DogeDay #DogeDay420 #tothemoon
Life has improved since the world introduced an endless supply of hype folk to tell me how rich this #Dogecoin is going to make me while I wait for it to make me rich.
This #dogecoin is on the move and I think it's got some room to run.  Next week will be interesting.
